g.text: Type OK? You proved the required statement without changing it.Closed under the global context? No unproved assumptions remain.A listed axiom can expose an Admitted theorem or helper dependency.
Check the course's allowed-axiom list separately.The final exercise summary does not replace the type check above it.Manually graded exercises still need human review.
Keep exercise names and statements; do not delete skipped tasks.Use Admitted for unfinished work, including dependent main proofs.Submit the assignment files, not BasicsTest.v or Preface.v.
